errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different levels of ambiguity
errors.evidence: The figure is actually a nested/concentric donut chart with two rings (outer ring for Ambiguity Std and inner ring for Max Ambiguity), not a simple pie chart.

errors.text_span: "Std: 0.0" colored in dark blue, representing approximately 47.7% of the total
errors.evidence: From the figure, 47.7% appears to correspond to Std: 0.47 (medium blue), not Std: 0.0 (dark blue). The dark blue segment (Std: 0.0) appears much smaller.

errors.text_span: "Std: 0.47" colored in light blue, accounting for approximately 7.0%
errors.evidence: The 7.0% label in the figure corresponds to a different segment. Std: 0.47 takes up a large portion (~47.7%) of the outer ring based on the legend color mapping.
The 49.0% is shown in the inner ring and corresponds to Max Ambiguity (Max: 1), not Std: 0.82. Std: 0.82 corresponds to a different percentage in the outer ring.

errors.text_span: "Max Ambiguity (Inner)" colored in light gray, representing approximately 14.2%
errors.evidence: Max Ambiguity is not a single slice but a category for the inner ring with three segments (Max: 1, Max: 2, Max: 3). 14.2% corresponds to one specific inner segment.

errors.text_span: "Max: 1, 2, 3" colored in light blue, representing approximately 38.0% and 39.0% respectively
errors.evidence: Max: 1, 2, and 3 are three separate inner ring segments. The description conflates them and incorrectly assigns percentages. The figure shows 49.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2% (approximately) for the inner segments, and these three values are separate slices not two.
Based on the figure, Std: 0.47 (dark/medium blue, 47.7%) appears to be the largest outer segment, not Std: 0.82.

The description fails to mention that this is a nested/concentric donut chart with two distinct rings (outer: Ambiguity Std with 4 categories, inner: Max Ambiguity with 3 categories), which is a fundamental structural feature.
The description does not clearly state that the outer ring represents Ambiguity Std and the inner ring represents Max Ambiguity as two separate distributions shown simultaneously.
The chart has two rings with a total of 7 segments: 4 in the outer ring (Std: 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94) and 3 in the inner ring (Max: 1, 2, 3), not five slices.
The description does not mention the Std: 0.94 category, which is one of the four outer ring segments shown in the legend.
Std: 0.47 corresponds to a medium/bright blue color in the legend, not light blue. Light blue corresponds to Std: 0.94.
